caption: The drawing depicts a metal teapot with an ornate, rounded body and a highly polished surface. The teapot features a decorative engraving on its side, likely a crest or emblem surrounded by detailed floral elements. The spout, positioned to the left, is gently curved and flows outward from the body. The lid is dome-shaped, topped with a finial, and bears a star-like marking. The handle, attached on the right side, is large, arching, and appears to be made of a darker material, possibly wood, which contrasts with the lighter metallic finish of the rest of the teapot. The image is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a monochromatic and realistic appearance, with detailed shading that emphasizes the reflective and three-dimensional qualities of the object. The background is plain and unadorned, allowing the teapot to stand out prominently.
title: Silver Teapot
